therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor cell proliferation driven by FGFR pathway activation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Previously treated locally advanced/metastatic or surgically unresectable solid tumor malignancies harboring activating FGFR mutations or translocations
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Objective Response Rate (ORR) based on RECIST v1.1 or RANO

results.effect_size: ORR 26.5% (95% CI: 14.95-41.08) in FGFR1-3 fusions/FGFR2 arrangements; ORR 9.4% (95% CI: 1.98-25.02) in FGFR1-3 mutations
subgroup_findings: Higher response rate in fusion/arrangement cohort (26.5%) vs mutation cohort (9.4%)
Median PFS 4.53 months in fusion cohort vs 3.68 months in mutation cohort
safety_signals: Treatment-related AEs in 94% of fusion cohort and 100% of mutation cohort
Serious AEs included abdominal pain, acute kidney injury, acute respiratory failure, blood bilirubin increased, blood creatinine increased
